flags.message: A predictor-named directory sits at events/evt-petition-disposition/gemini-baseline/ (tracked files prediction.json and reasoning.md) outside the predictions/ tree, so the harness's blinding move did not relocate it and it stayed in the working tree during this blinded evaluate run. I listed its filenames only and did not open either file, so the blind holds for this cell, but the path leaks a predictor name into the event root and should be moved under predictions/<predictor>/<run_id>/ or removed. Not a defect in any candidate; every candidate was scored from record/blinded/ only.
